name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
definition: For a teacher map $T$ assigning every $h\in\mathcal H$ a labeled sample $T(h)$ consistent with $h$, a pair $h\ne h'$ **clashes** when $T(h)$ is consistent with $h'$ and $T(h')$ is consistent with $h$. The **No-Clashing Teaching Dimension** is $\min_T\max_{h\in\mathcal H}|T(h)|$ over teacher maps with no clash.
graph_summary: Least maximum sample size of a teacher map with no mutually consistent distinct pair.
origin_references: Introduced as the no-clashing teaching dimension in \cite{KSZ2019}. This record uses the standard mutual-consistency definition; it makes no claimed VC-dimension upper bound.

monotonic.proof: Restricting a no-clashing teacher mapping to a subfamily preserves the no-clashing condition and cannot increase its maximum sample size.

c_monotonic.proof: Restrict a no-clashing teacher mapping to the conditioned fibre and delete fixed coordinates.  A clash in the fibre would already be a clash in the original class.
